name: Sandvik AB
tagline: Global leader in industrial tools, machinery, and digital solutions for mining, construction, and manufacturing
hero_kpi_rationale: La marge EBITA ajustée reflète la rentabilité opérationnelle core de Sandvik, excluant les éléments non récurrents. Elle démontre l'efficacité de la gestion et la capacité à générer de la valeur à partir des activités principales dans des secteurs cycliques (minier, construction, fabrication).

kpis.explanation: Total revenues from sales of goods and services generated by the company.
kpis.signal: Moderate revenue growth of 5% YoY, with 15% growth at fixed exchange rates and organically.
kpis.description: Q1 2026 revenues reached SEK 30,685 million, up 5% from Q1 2025 (SEK 29,301 million). At fixed exchange rates, revenues increased by 15%, and organically by 15%, demonstrating strong underlying demand across mining, construction, and machining segments.

kpis.explanation: Operating profit margin (EBITA) adjusted for items affecting comparability, expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.signal: Strong operating efficiency with adjusted EBITA margin at 20.0%, up from 19.7% in Q1 2025, within Sandvik's target range.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBITA increased by 6% to SEK 6,138 million with a margin of 20.0% (Q1 2025: 19.7%). This reflects operational excellence and successful execution of the profit growth strategy despite currency headwinds and restructuring costs in Machining.

kpis.explanation: Total value of new customer orders received during the period, indicating future revenue potential and demand strength.
kpis.signal: Strong order intake growth of 12% YoY, with 23% growth at fixed exchange rates and organically, indicating robust demand across all business areas.
kpis.description: Total order intake in Q1 2026 increased to SEK 36,756 million from SEK 32,763 million in Q1 2025. At fixed exchange rates, order intake grew by 23%, and organically by 23%, reflecting strong broad-based demand in Mining, Rock Processing, Machining, and Intelligent Manufacturing.

kpis.explanation: Cash generated from operations after capital expenditures, representing cash available for debt repayment and shareholder returns.
kpis.signal: Free operating cash flow of SEK 3.6 billion with 62% cash conversion, in line with normal seasonality despite -5% YoY decline.
kpis.description: Free operating cash flow in Q1 2026 was SEK 3,613 million compared to SEK 3,809 million in Q1 2025 (-5% YoY). Cash conversion rate of 62% is healthy and consistent with seasonal patterns. Full year 2025 free operating cash flow was SEK 21,216 million.

kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest and taxes (adjusted for items affecting comparability) expressed as a percentage of revenue.
kpis.signal: Adjusted EBIT margin improved to 18.6% in Q1 2026 from 18.0% in Q1 2025, demonstrating continued operational leverage.
kpis.description: Adjusted EBIT reached SEK 5,719 million in Q1 2026, up 9% from SEK 5,262 million in Q1 2025, with margin expanding to 18.6% from 18.0%. Full year 2025 adjusted EBIT margin was 17.8%.

kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to shareholders divided by weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding.
kpis.signal: EPS diluted grew 4% to SEK 3.09, with adjusted EPS growing 8% to SEK 3.27, reflecting strong profitability.
kpis.description: Earnings per share (diluted) increased to SEK 3.09 in Q1 2026 from SEK 2.97 in Q1 2025 (+4%). Adjusted EPS diluted increased 8% to SEK 3.27 from SEK 3.01. Full year 2025 EPS was SEK 11.70 with adjusted EPS of SEK 12.17.

stories_kpis.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Mining business segment, excluding acquisitions and currency effects.
stories_kpis.signal: Exceptional organic order growth in Mining with double-digit growth in both equipment and aftermarket.
stories_kpis.description: Mining segment achieved 22% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026, with double-digit expansion in both equipment and aftermarket. Strong demand for AutoMine automation solutions, highlighted by multiple orders from a major customer now operating globally with AutoMine technology.

stories_kpis.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Machining business segment, driven by strong demand in strategic end-markets.
stories_kpis.signal: Exceptional 28% organic order intake growth driven by aerospace, defense, medical segments and tungsten market dynamics.
stories_kpis.description: Machining reported exceptional 28% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026. Powder business more than doubled, cutting tools grew 18%. Strong demand in aerospace, defense, and medical segments, with significant benefit from favorable global tungsten market dynamics and vertical supply chain integration.

stories_kpis.name_fr: Croissance organique des commandes Rock Processing
stories_kpis.explanation: Organic growth rate of order intake in the Rock Processing business segment.
stories_kpis.signal: Strong organic order growth of 12% in Rock Processing driven by equipment demand and infrastructure sentiment.
stories_kpis.description: Rock Processing achieved 12% organic order intake growth in Q1 2026, driven by equipment orders. Q1 is a key indicator for underlying infrastructure market sentiment with pre-ordering ahead of summer activities. Strong pre-ordering and recovery in demolition and recycling, as well as aggregates.

stories_kpis.explanation: Combined organic growth of order intake and revenues for the new Intelligent Manufacturing standalone business area.
stories_kpis.signal: Solid 11% organic growth in software and digital solutions with high-double-digit subscription growth.
stories_kpis.description: Intelligent Manufacturing, launching as a standalone business area in Q1 2026, achieved 11% organic growth in both order intake and revenues. Strong performance in North America and aerospace/defense segments. Subscription revenues grew high-double-digits, supporting strategic shift toward recurring revenue models.

ai_positioning.summary: Sandvik integrates digital solutions and automation in its industrial equipment and processes, enhancing efficiency and productivity. The newly standalone Intelligent Manufacturing business area focuses on software, digital services, and subscription-based solutions. While not a direct AI developer, Sandvik uses digital technologies and data analytics to optimize operations and strengthen competitive positioning.
evidence: Launched My Sandvik Geo, an advanced cloud-based digital service for drilling data transformation.
Strong growth in Intelligent Manufacturing segment with software and subscription solutions.
Multiple new digital product launches including software versions and connected equipment offerings.
Acquisition of ThoroughTec Simulation to strengthen digital and aftermarket capabilities.
